The firm shows somewhat weak liquidity (current ratio 0.91) and high leverage (total liabilities are ~74% of total assets), increasing refinancing and risk sensitivity. However, profitability is solid for an operating-basis measure (EBIT of 5,004 on revenue of 36,381 implies ~14% margin), and retained earnings are substantial, which provides some cushion. Overall credit quality looks in the speculative lower range.
